learning.learning_goal: Identify and make a pair with one object from each of two groups.
learning.big_idea: A pair here has one blue dot and one red dot together.
assumed_prior_knowledge: Count objects to ten and answer how many.

screens.label: Next step
screens.title: Put two dots together.
screens.body: You can count dots. Now we will put one blue dot and one red dot together.

visual.ariaLabel: Three blue dots in a top row and two red dots below.
visual.message: The blue dots are one group. The red dots are another group.

visual.ariaLabel: One blue dot above one red dot, together inside one border.
visual.message: One blue dot and one red dot are together. These two dots make one pair.

screens.label: Try it
screens.title: Which dots make one pair?

visual.ariaLabel: Two blue dots and one red dot. The first blue dot and red dot are together; the second blue dot is alone.
visual.message: Look at the blue dot with a red dot below it.

choices.feedback: Look for two dots together: one blue and one red.

choices.text: One blue and one red dot together
choices.feedback: Yes. One blue and one red dot together make one pair.
The dot alone is not a pair. Find the blue and red dots together.

hints: A pair here needs one blue dot and one red dot.
Find a blue dot with a red dot directly below it.

visual.ariaLabel: Three blue dots, each above one red dot; three matched pairs.
visual.message: Each blue dot is together with one red dot. Count the blue-and-red pairs: one, two, three.

screens.label: Your turn
screens.title: How many pairs are here?

visual.ariaLabel: Four blue dots and three red dots. Three blue dots are above red dots; the fourth blue dot is alone.
visual.message: Count the blue-and-red pairs. The blue dot alone is not a pair.

choices.feedback: Four is how many blue dots there are. Count only blue-and-red pairs.
One blue dot is alone. Count the blue-and-red pairs instead.
There are three pairs. Each has a blue dot and a red dot together.

hints: Look for blue dots with red dots below them.
Count only the places with both a blue dot and a red dot.

screens.label: Remember
screens.title: What makes a pair?
screens.hook: One blue plus one red, together.
screens.body: In this lesson, two dots make a pair when one is blue and one is red and they are together.

screens.label: Remember
screens.title: What makes a pair here?
screens.prompt: Which two dots could you put together to make one pair?

choices.text: One blue dot and one red dot
choices.feedback: Yes. Put one of each color together to make a pair.

hints: Look for one blue dot and one red dot.

screens.label: New example
screens.title: Make pairs in a new group.

visual.ariaLabel: Five blue dots in a row and four red dots in a row directly below the first four blue dots.
visual.message: Put one red dot with one blue dot above it. How many pairs can you make?

choices.feedback: Five counts every blue dot. One blue dot has no red dot to make a pair.
Four red dots can each go with one blue dot. That makes four pairs.
One blue dot is alone. Count the blue-and-red pairs instead.

hints: Look at each red dot. Find one blue dot directly above it.
Count the places with both colors, leaving the blue dot alone out.

screens.title: You made pairs.
screens.body: Next, use pairs to see how many more dots are in one group.
